title: Vacation Budget Planner
description: Plan trip costs: flights plus per-day costs times days, split per person.
howto: Enter the number of travelers and trip days.
Enter total flights and the per-night hotel cost.
Enter per-person daily costs for food, activities, and local transport, plus any lump-sum extras.
Read the trip total, cost per person, and cost per person per day.

faqs.q: Are flights per person or total?
faqs.a: Enter the total for all flights. Per-person daily costs are multiplied by travelers and days automatically.
Lump sums like visas, travel insurance, souvenirs, or airport parking.

faqs.q: Does it handle different trip lengths per person?
faqs.a: No. It assumes everyone travels the full trip. Adjust manually for partial stays.
